_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for LAP-NEW-TERM. Two assertions in schemaFixtureFactory.test.ts: (1) live hand-written LAP_NEW_TERM.payload in formPathScenarios.ts deep-equals this snapshot; (2) toScenario(LAP_NEW_TERM_JOURNEY).payload deep-equals this snapshot. Both must pass before Step-5 in-place rewrites.
_source: src/lib/testing/scenarios/formPathScenarios.ts :: LAP_NEW_TERM.payload (rewritten 2026-04-22 to match buildLoanPayload output from LAP_NEW_TERM_JOURNEY).
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario used idealized payload keys that the current LAP schema + builder cannot produce. Corrections: (1) propertyType 'Independent House' REMOVED — LAP's q3_propertyType binds propertyType to ownership-type values ('Free Hold'/'Lease Hold'), so the builder surfaces the ownership value (here 'Free Hold'). (2) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'House' — builder maps constructionType answer → constructionStatus, and LAP constructionType options are House/Flat/Floor/Shop/Office/Building/etc; there is no 'Ready to Move' value. (3) propertyIdentified: true → false — LAP schema has no propertyIdentified question, so builder's toBoolean(undefined) yields false. (4) carpetArea unit added (Feet) + carpetAreaRaw — builder normalizes these. (5) societyStatus 'NONE' + floodDisasterZone 'No' + zoneClassification 'RESIDENTIAL' + municipalTaxStatus 'PAID_REGULAR' added — these are real schema keys that flow through. (6) propertyAcquisitionMethod 'self_purchased' added — valid option value. (7) applicantResidingInProperty: true added (from propertyIdentificationPage). (8) existingEncumbrance 'None' → 'No' — valid schema option value. (9) originalDocumentsAvailable/ownershipChainComplete/noLegalDispute/encumbranceCertificateVerified normalized to Yes/No/CLEAR enum values. (10) ocCcAvailable/municipalApproval NOT set — both have showWhen that excludes constructionType='House' and categoryOfProperty='Residential' requires House/Flat/Floor/Shop/Office/Building/Row House; House is excluded from ocCcAvailable's constructionType list (Flat/Floor/Building/Office/Shop). municipalApproval shows for non-Plot Residential/Mixed + q1a answered, so YES it fires — check dump. Actually kept only municipalApproval: APPROVED (shown for Residential + House). ocCcAvailable filtered out (House not in its allowed list). (11) obligations entry id set to deterministic 'lap-new-term-ob-1' so snapshot is stable across runs (builder generates UUIDs if id is absent).
_shift_notes_bugA_fix_2026_05_28: Session 2 BUG-A / Plot Construction sizing fix (2026-05-28 late-evening): `buildLoanTransactionPayload` in payloadBuilder/loanTransaction.ts now derives loanAmount in a type-aware way:   • Balance Transfer Only        → principalOutstanding   • Top-up Only                  → topUpAmount   • Balance Transfer With Top-up → principalOutstanding + topUpAmount   • Plot Loan BT (via PlotLoanActivity flag) → principalOutstanding   • Construction Loan Only       → requiredExtraAmount - downPayment   • Plot & Construction Loan     → (propCost + requiredExtraAmount) - downPayment   • everything else              → existing RequiredLoanAmount / loanAmount / sanctionAmount chain Before the fix, BT-Only/Top-up-Only/BT+Topup all fell through to either sanctionAmount (Top-up) or the propertyCost-downPayment fallback (BT-Only), evaluating the customer against the wrong amount → false RED rejections across every lender. Plot Construction loans were similarly mis-sized, either under-requesting (Construction Only) or under-valuing the LTV base (Plot & Construction). For Plot Construction variants, propertyCost now also includes the construction cost so LTV caps fire against the full project value. Field SHAPE unchanged — only loanAmount + propertyCost VALUES move.
_shift_notes_lend_2026_06_02: LEND-1 session 2026-06-02 — two concurrent payload-builder fixes: (1) Phase 1b (ADR-0025): Plot & Equity Loan canonical-field aliasing — propCost → marketValue, agreementSellValue → registryValue, derived sellerCashComponent (= marketValue − registryValue). Gated on loanVariant === "Plot & Equity Loan", affects PLOT-EQUITY only. (2) propertyIdentified force-true for Plot Loan + LAP — neither form asks the question, so the prior coercion to false hid real Plot/LAP deals from downstream consumers. Affects 5 LAP snapshots + 2 LAP-EDGE snapshots. Plot snapshots already had propertyIdentified=true (set via journey fixtures) so they need no field-value flip — but PLOT-EQUITY still needs regen for the new aliased fields. Home Loan paths are unaffected by both.
